notes: Draft configuration: The official Mountain Course map identifies the full loop through Quarterbridge, Ballacraine, Kirk Michael, Ballaugh, Ramsey, the Mountain Road and the old Governor's Bridge dip. Independent circuit relation 188240 supplies that named road corridor. Its omitted short junction connection to the dip is supplied by the existing public way 38554715 node slice 8 to 6. The short direct junction arcs follow the course corridor rather than detouring around the public-traffic roundabouts. Exact mapped road coordinates are preserved, measuring 60672.4 m against the catalogue scalar of 60583 m. Local junction geometry, temporary race arrangements and historical alignment remain draft rather than a certified racing line. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 60672.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 250 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
